methods.title: Annual values interpolated to quarters
steps: Treat each annual value as the value at the middle of its year.
Interpolate linearly between consecutive mid-year points to obtain each quarter.

methods.title: District income ratio extended from the latest trend
steps: Fit a linear trend to the district ratio over the latest published years.
Extend the trend to the quarters after the last published year.

methods.title: District household income from city income and district ratio
steps: Multiply the city disposable income by the district relative median income of the same quarter.

methods.title: 2015 migration split into quarters
steps: Take the annual 2015 move-in and move-out totals of the district.
Split them over the four quarters using the seasonal shares of later years.

methods.title: Sale price from a pooled window for thin cells
steps: When a district-quarter has too few records, widen the window to neighbouring quarters.
Take the median unit price of the pooled records.

methods.title: Rent per m² carried by the city rent price index
steps: Compute the district rent level from rental records where enough exist.
Move the level between quarters with the rent index of the city.

methods.title: Rent from MOI rent statistics for reference districts
steps: Use the published district rent level as the anchor.
Move the level between quarters with the rent index of the city.
methods.quarters: reference districts covered by MOI rent statistics

methods.title: Rent from the sale price and a reference rent-to-price ratio
steps: Multiply the district sale price by the rent-to-price ratio observed in reference districts.
Move the level between quarters with the rent index of the city.
methods.quarters: reference districts not covered by MOI rent statistics

methods.title: Price-to-income ratio computed from city series
steps: Divide the city median home price by the city disposable income of the same quarter.

methods.title: Metro entries split into quarters
steps: Assign each station to the district containing it.
Where only coarser totals exist, split them over the quarters using the seasonal shares of available periods.
methods.quarters: every quarter of a district with an Active_Station
